prompt: Inspect the request using read-only commands only: run exactly `cat REQUEST.md`; do not run any other command. Do not execute project code or tests, and do not create, modify, or delete files. Explore the problem deeply without converging prematurely. Separate researchable facts, owner decisions, and testable uncertainties; order blocking dependencies; state the three-round default limit; ask exactly one focused question about the highest-leverage unresolved item; and treat any prototype as a separately authorized experiment. Do not select a design or create a persistent artifact.
secondary_criteria: Keep the problem before solutions; distinguish researchable facts, owner decisions, and testable uncertainties; identify blocking dependencies; ask exactly one focused highest-leverage question; state the default limit of three rounds and a stop condition; do not select a winner, require a specification or tickets, create a file, or claim a prototype was run; treat a prototype as separately authorized and name the cheapest next evidence.
